note: One home per fact — the rule is .claude/rules/specs.md. A phrase listed under "owned" may be stated in its owner and nowhere else; every other document links to the owner. Enforced by `pnpm lint:docs` (check-docs.mjs), a step of the CI static job. Add an entry when a fact starts appearing in a second file, and pick the owner from the layer that would have to change if the fact changed. "forbidden" holds the words that may not appear anywhere in the repository, prose and code alike; this file is the only place they are written.

owned.note: why the digit count is not the ISO exponent
why apps/api reports two coverage directories
budget scoping filters reads only, and refuses a read with no active budget
one active budget per user, and the preview feature the index costs

banned.why: an em dash is the loudest AI tell; end the sentence or use a comma (communication.md)

banned.pattern: \b(in order to|due to the fact that|it is important to note that)\b

banned.why: a war story, not an instruction — specs.md forbids it; the decision belongs to its Notion ticket
state the rule, not the measurement — specs.md
a reproduction transcript goes stale; state what must hold instead — specs.md
a dated observation is false on the next release — specs.md

forbidden.why: a competitor's name and trademark. This project is described by what it does, not by which product it resembles (communication.md)
